name: Italian Founders Fund
identity_check: Confirmed as italianfoundersfund.com, the Milan VC managed by Koinos Capital SGR and described on its site as Italy's first founder-backed VC; Vestbee (2025-08-05) names it Italian Founders Fund (IFF), managed by Koinos Capital SGR. Not the Dutch Founders Fund or DFF Ventures (separate co-investor), nor Italian Angels or CDP Venture Capital (an LP).
